source_geometry.extraction: two physical source neck mesh convex hulls; common most-upward facet plane; complete inward segments in a source hull
source_geometry.projection: Gz only; preserve string x/y; existing surface geometry with negative inward margin
source_geometry.scope: Approach observation/reward target only; no contact/success or physics changes. Source convex hull proof, not exact PhysX cooked geometry or pressure certification.

pad_contract.coordinate_frame: distal body local after source mesh scale/geom transform
pad_contract.sampling: actual eligible triangle clipping then equal-area CDF strata and deterministic barycentric interiors
pad_contract.normals: unit outward triangle cross-product after mesh scale/geom transform

frame_source.rest_rotation: identity for palm-relative finger1 and consecutive finger2/3/top
frame_source.attachment: palm-to-finger1 position may vary; segment direction is defined by child2/3/top offsets
frame_source.limitation: actual source-body geometric flexion; not native spherical coordinates or anatomical range certification

pad_contract.limitation: model flexion-side engineering patch; not anatomical annotation, native contact location or pressure certification; finite samples may miss contacts

fk: current source exponential joints calibrated to prepared actual poses/q; no simulator

search.objective: nearest actual distal patch to cell midpoint plus weak near-facing/pose prior
search.contact_request: 0.5mm nominal inward source-plane overlap; no state/collision/PD override and no pressure guarantee
search.limitation: Finite local optimization does not prove reachability or infeasibility
